newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-E.P. IN COMMAND AGAINST FREE STATE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-E.P. IN COMMAND AGAINST FREE STATE.

text.p: Eastern Province took firm control on the opening day of their Supersport Series match against Free State in Bloemfontein on Friday.
They closed the day on 131 for three, having bowled out the home side for 178 to be just 47 in arrears with seven wickets in hand.

Alan Badenhorst did the damage after E.P. won the toss, finishing with figures of four for 39 from just ten overs with assistance from Dave Callaghan (two for 29) and West Indian all-rounder Eldine Baptiste (two for 30).
Free State opener Deon Jordaan and 17-year-old debutant Morne van Wyk were the only batsmen to show any resistance, although both of them fell just short of half-centuries.
E.P. were in early trouble at 20 for two but Kepler Wessels grabbed his second life after being dropped at second slip on three to score his sixth half-century of the season.
Louis Koen also moved closer to taking Ken McEwan's E.P. scoring record for a season of 846 runs by hitting 57, and now needs 33 in the second innings to move ahead.
Bowling: Ferreira 12-2-43-1, Badenhorst 10-2-39-4, Callaghan 14-3-29-2, Baptiste 14-5-30-2, Shaw 11.1-3-34-1
Bowling: Pretorius 10-0-40-0, Cilliers 10-045-2, Bakkes 7-2-23-0, Cronje 10-4-15-0, Boje 4-2-6-0, Venter 1-0-1-1
Bonus points: Free State 2, Eastern Province 4
